# Documentation for Deployment Process

```{r}
renv::init()

lib_dir <- renv::paths$library()

# downgrade raster version for GDAL version matching on server
url_raster <- "https://packagemanager.posit.co/cran/2024-03-01/bin/windows/contrib/4.3/raster_3.6-26.zip"
zip_raster <- tempfile(fileext = ".zip")
download.file(url_raster, zip_raster, mode = "wb")
unzip(zip_raster, exdir = lib_dir)
file.remove(zip_raster)

# same as above for terra
url_terra <- "https://packagemanager.posit.co/cran/2024-03-01/bin/windows/contrib/4.3/terra_1.7-71.zip"
zip_terra <- tempfile(fileext = ".zip")
download.file(url_terra, zip_terra, mode = "wb")
unzip(zip_terra, exdir = lib_dir)
file.remove(zip_terra)

# same as above for sf
lib_dir <- renv::paths$library()
binary_url <- "https://packagemanager.posit.co/cran/2024-03-01/bin/windows/contrib/4.3/sf_1.0-15.zip"
temp_zip <- tempfile(fileext = ".zip")
download.file(binary_url, temp_zip, mode = "wb")
unzip(temp_zip, exdir = lib_dir)
file.remove(temp_zip)


renv::snapshot()

# add following line to top of .Rprofile file
options(repos = c(CRAN = "https://packagemanager.posit.co/cran/latest"))

rsconnect::writeManifest() # to write manifest.json file needed for Posit deployment

```

## Errors Encountered
After deployment, the Shiny application was failing to run, due to Linux being case-sensitive, but not Windows? Species_codes.csv was called as Species_Codes.csv. Once these matched, app deployed and ran as expected.

## After Code Cell
After running provided code cell, commit and push changes to main branch. Deploy using Git Connect of Posit GUI.
